title.zh-CN: 幼年起肥胖伴视力下降与新发高血糖
title.en: Childhood-onset obesity, visual decline and newly detected hyperglycaemia

summary.zh-CN: 年轻女性从小有体型、视力和手足发育特点，近期发现高血糖，需要整合多系统信息并提供可理解的沟通。
summary.en: A young woman has longstanding body, visual and digit-development findings with new hyperglycaemia, requiring multisystem assessment and accessible communication.

provenance.citation: 肖淳纯, 叶山东, 任安, 胡圆圆, 方芳, 王炜. Bardet－Biedl综合征一例. 中华糖尿病杂志. 2011;03(06):501-502. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1674-5809.2011.06.013.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: FDA 2026 IMCIVREE label checked 2026-10-28 to avoid obsolete no-specific-treatment claim; eligibility/dosing not prescribed in this adaptation.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合多趾和视网膜证据。
制定可及沟通及低血糖预防。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan accessible communication and hypoglycaemia prevention.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 肥胖十四年，发现血糖升高两周
chiefComplaint.en: Obesity for fourteen years and high glucose detected two weeks ago

triageNote.zh-CN: 患者表达和视力受限，陪同者仅协助转述既有记录。
triageNote.en: Speech and vision are limited; a companion helps relay documented information.

personality.zh-CN: 按当前阶段记录提供信息；交流方式为教学设定。
personality.en: Provides information from the current stage; conversational style is an educational convention.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用日常语言叙述，检查数值由病历提供。
speechStyle.en: Uses everyday language; numerical results come from the records.

openingLine.zh-CN: 出生一个月左右被注意到偏重，六岁后明显肥胖。

fallbackUnknown.en: I am not sure about that, doctor.

actingNotes.en: Use only facts documented for the current phase; do not anticipate later results.

maneuver.zh-CN: 核对体型、指趾和视网膜
maneuver.en: Review body size, digits and retina

finding.zh-CN: 身高150 cm、BMI48.9 kg/m²，X形腿、皱褶部位黑棘皮样改变，双足12趾；视力<0.01，视网膜色素沉着。
finding.en: Height 150 cm and BMI 48.9 kg/m², knock knees, acanthosis-like flexural changes and twelve toes; acuity <0.01 with retinal pigmentation.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。
source.en: Adapted from the source case record; dialogue is a de-identified educational paraphrase.

text.zh-CN: 空腹血糖13.6 mmol/L；餐试验高糖伴保留C肽，HOMA-IR8.64。肝肾功能和电解质正常，超声脂肪肝；未报告专门长期肾脏筛查。
text.en: Fasting glucose 13.6 mmol/L; meal testing showed hyperglycaemia with preserved C-peptide and HOMA-IR 8.64. Liver/renal function and electrolytes were normal; ultrasound showed fatty liver without documented dedicated longitudinal renal surveillance.

note.en: Review of an investigation already completed in the source; it is not repeated in in-world mode.

text.zh-CN: 肥胖、多趾、视网膜色素变性及发育学习困难支持原报告Bardet–Biedl临床诊断。无分子结果。部分性激素数值单位可疑，不用于建立额外内分泌诊断。
text.en: Obesity, polydactyly, retinal degeneration and developmental/learning difficulties supported the source’s clinical Bardet–Biedl diagnosis. No molecular result was supplied. Some sex-hormone units are questionable and are not used to create additional endocrine diagnoses.

text.zh-CN: 原报告多种降糖治疗后控制改善，出院后频繁低血糖，逐步减少并两周后停胰岛素，后续血糖良好，约三个月体重107.5 kg。
text.en: Combined glucose treatment improved control, but frequent post-discharge hypoglycaemia led to insulin reduction and withdrawal after two weeks. Subsequent control was good and weight was 107.5 kg at about three months.

hint.zh-CN: 问清主诉、进展、关联症状和关键既往史。
hint.en: Clarify presentation, progression, associated symptoms and relevant history.

hint.zh-CN: 关注哪些体征能帮助定位，并保留未记录的信息。
hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

hint.zh-CN: 将检查结果放回时间线；比较能够解释全部证据的方向。
hint.en: Place findings in their timeline and compare explanations for the complete evidence.

title.en: Plan care and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 区分已报告处置与当前教学计划，核对后续变化。
hint.en: Distinguish reported care from the educational plan and review subsequent changes.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.zh-CN: 是否可把本例只作为一般肥胖糖尿病？
prompt.en: Can this be treated as ordinary obesity-associated diabetes alone?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 应评估综合征性肥胖，整合先天指趾、视网膜及发育特点
text.en: Assess syndromic obesity by integrating congenital digits, retinal and developmental findings

feedback.zh-CN: 跨系统组合不能由饮食习惯单独解释。
feedback.en: The multisystem pattern cannot be attributed to diet alone.

text.zh-CN: 全部问题都归因于个人不自律
text.en: Attribute everything to poor self-discipline

feedback.zh-CN: 忽略先天和进行性器官表现，也是不恰当沟通。
feedback.en: This ignores congenital and progressive organ findings and is inappropriate communication.

text.zh-CN: 血糖发现两周足以解释从九岁起失明
text.en: Two weeks of detected hyperglycaemia explains visual loss since nine

feedback.zh-CN: 病程顺序不支持这一简单归因。
feedback.en: The chronology does not support that attribution.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: BBS临床表型较完整，但基因和长期器官风险仍需评估
text.en: The clinical BBS phenotype is substantial, while genetics and long-term organ risks still need assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 正常一次肌酐不等于没有未来肾脏风险。
feedback.en: One normal creatinine does not establish absence of future renal risk.

text.zh-CN: 近亲婚配已证明具体BBS基因
text.en: Consanguinity proves a particular BBS gene

feedback.zh-CN: 遗传方式线索不能指定基因。
feedback.en: An inheritance clue does not identify a gene.

text.zh-CN: 所有BBS患者必须已有性腺发育不全
text.en: Every BBS patient must already have hypogonadism

feedback.zh-CN: 表型可变，本例有规律月经及已记录正常外生殖器。
feedback.en: Phenotypes vary and this case had regular menses and documented normal external genitalia.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前长期计划应强调什么？
prompt.en: What should a current long-term plan emphasise?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 遗传、眼科、肾科和代谢联合照护，采用可及沟通并防低血糖，评估现有治疗选择
text.en: Coordinate genetics, eye, renal and metabolic care with accessible communication, hypoglycaemia prevention and review of current options

feedback.zh-CN: 现代已有针对部分BBS肥胖的获批治疗，旧文“无特殊治疗”不能当永久结论。
feedback.en: Approved treatment for some BBS-related obesity now exists; the historical absence of specific therapy is not a permanent conclusion.

text.zh-CN: 旧文说无特效药所以不再评估治疗
text.en: Stop reviewing treatment because the old article said none existed

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗证据与许可随时间变化。
feedback.en: Evidence and authorisations change over time.

text.zh-CN: 照搬旧多药方案不考虑低血糖和表达障碍
text.en: Copy historical polypharmacy without considering hypoglycaemia or communication limits

feedback.zh-CN: 后续已经发生频繁低血糖，应预防和调整。
feedback.en: Frequent hypoglycaemia occurred later and requires prevention and adjustment.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 提供可及的多学科照护并主动防范低血糖
text.en: Provide accessible multidisciplinary care and actively prevent hypoglycaemia

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明先天指趾与进行性视力改变帮助识别综合征。；承认分子结果、完整肾脏长期评估及性激素单位核验缺失。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Congenital digits and progressive visual loss identify a syndromic pattern.; acknowledge Molecular results, longitudinal renal assessment and verified sex-hormone units are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为临床Bardet–Biedl综合征伴肥胖、视网膜病和糖尿病，未分子确诊。
conclusion.en: The report describes clinical Bardet–Biedl syndrome with obesity, retinal disease and diabetes without molecular confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先天指趾与进行性视力改变帮助识别综合征。
keyReasoning.en: Congenital digits and progressive visual loss identify a syndromic pattern.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 临床诊断与特定基因不同。
keyReasoning.en: Clinical diagnosis differs from a specific gene diagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低血糖和可及沟通是实际安全问题。
keyReasoning.en: Hypoglycaemia and accessible communication are practical safety issues.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不沿用旧基因数量或无治疗结论。
teachingPoints.en: Do not repeat obsolete gene counts or absence-of-treatment claims.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 一次正常肾功能不终止随访。
teachingPoints.en: One normal renal test does not end surveillance.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 分子结果、完整肾脏长期评估及性激素单位核验缺失。
unknowns.en: Molecular results, longitudinal renal assessment and verified sex-hormone units are missing.
